races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF (C & G) Maiden
races.verdict:
FRANCILLON can win this en route to much better things after his highly-encouraging debut at Killarney. Aidan O'Brien has won 2 of the 3 runnings of this maiden and his costly debutant Wall Street is an obvious contender, while stablemate Drumbeat is potentially a big improver having proved very green at the Curragh.

  1. FRANCILLON
  2. WALL STREET
  3. DRUMBEAT (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
races.verdict:
HARD PROMISES has made a positive start to his career, third behind a pair of more experienced rivals at Navan on his latest outing, and he could be ready to get off the mark this time around. Handani is feared most with more still to offer this year, while Magnum Cor makes plenty of appeal on debut.

  1. HARD PROMISES (IRE)
  2. HANDANI (IRE)
  3. MAGNUM COR (IRE)

races.name: Bahrain Turf Club Desmond Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
AUDIENCE is still capable of smart form and could have a tactical advantage around here over 3-y-os Sparan Nua, Al Haarith, and Needle Match.

  1. AUDIENCE
  2. SPARAN NUA (IRE)
  3. AL HAARITH (IRE)

races.name: Ballyroan Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
ETHICAL DIAMOND hasn't been at his best either start this year but can take advantage of this marked drop in class (escapes a penalty). Endorsement continues to hold his form well and is next best ahead of fellow 3-y-o Asakir, who remains with potential back down in distance.

  1. ETHICAL DIAMOND (IRE)
  2. ENDORSEMENT (IRE)
  3. ASAKIR (IRE)

races.name: Carnival de Leop Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
In an open-looking handicap, it could be worth taking a chance on class-dropper IMPERIAL DREAM. The most interesting of the remainder may be Gordon Bennett, who's slipped to a handy mark. Launch Time, Dinamine and Pete's Dream also appeal.

  1. IMPERIAL DREAM (IRE)
  2. GORDON BENNETT (IRE)
  3. LAUNCH TIME

races.name: Renault Ireland Handicap
races.verdict:
Last year's winner SINBAD MY DAD has dropped to a fair mark and acquitted himself well in a higher grade here last time. He may be able to take the prize home again. Bella Colombia, Tachos and Jasmine Affanalis make up the shortlist.

  1. SINBAD MY DAD (IRE)
  2. BELLA COLOMBIA (IRE)
  3. TACHOS (IRE)

races.name: Fegentri World Championship (Q.R.) Handicap
races.verdict:
HE WHO DARES backed up last month's hurdle success with a good third on the Flat at Tramore and likely has more to offer in this sphere yet. He makes plenty of appeal. Miss Gitana and Makaiah are also of interest.

  1. HE WHO DARES (IRE)
  2. MISS GITANA (IRE)
  3. MAKAIAH (IRE)

races.name: Westcare Home Care Claiming Hurdle
races.verdict:
Only a handful come under serious consideration in this with RAYDAMANN taken to add to his recent course success in similar company. Rich Belief may have to settle for another minor role behind the selection, with Oh So Charming not one to dismiss on these terms.

  1. RAYDAMANN (FR)
  2. RICH BELIEF
  3. OH SO CHARMING

races.name: Martin Reilly Hyundai Mares Maiden Hurdle
Martin Reilly Hyundai Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
This looks to revolve around CIRCUS HILL, who offered something to work on in this sphere back in the spring and Mark McNiff's mare has run really well in a couple of subsequent course bumpers (first past the post last month but demoted for interference). Sea Feliz showed precious little on debut, but she's surely capable of much better, with Speisialta and My Elusive Mate rounding off the shortlist.

  1. CIRCUS HILL (IRE)
  2. SEA FELIZ (IRE)
  3. SPEISIALTA (IRE)

races.name: Kilcawley Construction Rated Novice Hurdle
races.verdict:
MANOIR DE MIRANDE has been impressive in landing back-to-back novice hurdles, including over C&D, finding a decisive turn of speed to account for Crystabel at Ballinrobe a fortnight ago. Stepping into rated company, he's fancied to continue his progress. Firebrand could prove his biggest threat if bouncing back to the form of his promising reappearance.

  1. MANOIR DE MIRANDE (FR)
  2. FIREBRAND (GER)
  3. CRYSTABEL (IRE)

races.name: SIS Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
JUSTICIALISM hasn't won for a very long time, but Noel Kelly's 8-y-o has been knocking at the door of late and with this step back up in trip in his favour, he could be worth chancing back hurdling. General Clermont has been given a chance by the handicapper, so he's put forward as the biggest threat if on a going day, with Steps In The Sand and Andyourbirdcansing a couple of others worth considering.

  1. JUSTICIALISM (IRE)
  2. GENERAL CLERMONT (FR)
  3. STEPS IN THE SAND (IRE)

races.name: Mulhern Leonard Chartered Accountants Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
MINELLA MOON SHINE showed plenty of promise when narrowly denied at Roscommon a month ago and remains open to improvement over this sort of trip despite a lesser effort on Tuesday. Fox Walk is a point winner who could be capable of making an impact first time up under Rules, while Cut The Rope has the experience and form to figure.

  1. MINELLA MOON SHINE (IRE)
  2. FOX WALK (IRE)
  3. CUT THE ROPE (FR)

races.name: Lighthouse At Clifford Electrical Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
LITTLEBIGGIE is potentially well treated over hurdles and she could be the answer dropped to a more suitable trip after her encouraging comeback at Kilbeggan. You Make Me Smile and Jupiter Du Gite head the dangers.

  1. LITTLEBIGGIE (IRE)
  2. YOU MAKE ME SMILE (IRE)
  3. JUPITER DU GITE (FR)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares (Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict:
This could be a good opportunity for Willie Mullins' PEAT SOUNDS to make a winning start. Point winner Tanga Mugi looks interesting on her first run under Rules, while Carleys Lilly sets the standard of those with bumper experience.

  1. PEAT SOUNDS (IRE)
  2. TANGA MUGI (IRE)
  3. CARLEYS LILLY (IRE)

races.name: Corinthian Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
WHAT'S THE PLAN has taken his form up a level in defeat this season and James Fanshawe's 3-y-o looks ready to add to his tally. He gets the vote over Warning Sign, who landed back-to-back course wins here last summer (including this race) and arrives on the back of a career-best having bolted up at Goodwood 8 weeks ago. Drumstick looks best of the rest provided he's ready to roll after 3 months off.

  1. WHAT'S THE PLAN
  2. WARNING SIGN (FR)
  3. DRUMSTICK

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Preference is for CATCHING DREAMS, who finished with a flourish but was unable to peg back a more experienced rival that got first run at Lingfield just under 2 weeks ago. With improvement on the cards, Charlie Appleby's colt can get the better of Elevating who seemed stretched by 7f last week and drops to the minimum trip for the first time. Menhaal and Pulse of Fire can fight out minor honours.

  1. CATCHING DREAMS
  2. ELEVATING
  3. MENHAAL (IRE)

races.name: Chasemore Farm EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A pair of the world's most famous and powerful breeding empires lock horns in this maiden, FIRST LAW selected to make a winning start having fetched 1,000,000 gns as a yearling. Ralph Beckett's Sea The Stars colt Flight Tracker rates as the obvious threat.

  1. FIRST LAW (IRE)
  2. FLIGHT TRACKER
  3. CROWN RANGER (IRE)

races.name: Hwfa Williams - Founder Of Sandown Park Handicap
races.verdict:
INTERSTATE took another step forward after 8 months off when second on his qualifying run at Doncaster 2 weeks ago and appealing as the type to improve further as he gains more experience, he's fancied to make a bold bid on handicap debut. Edwin Hubble edges things for forecast purposes ahead of Elan D'or.

  1. INTERSTATE
  2. EDWIN HUBBLE (IRE)
  3. ELAN D'OR

races.name: BetMGM 80s Day Saturday 29 August Handicap
races.verdict:
ASCENDING STAR arguably did too much too soon with front-running tactics retained when third on handicap debut here last month but with the drop to 7f in his favour, Owen Burrows' 3-y-o is fancied to double his tally. His main danger may emerge from Thursday Girl, who took advantage of a good opportunity at Nottingham recently and should remain competitive back in a handicap. Desert Shadow rounds off the shortlist.

  1. ASCENDING STAR (IRE)
  2. THURSDAY GIRL
  3. DESERT SHADOW

races.name: Community Fund For Elmbridge Handicap
races.verdict:
GREAT BLASKET made the perfect start for new connections at Nottingham last week and remaining well treated under a 5-lb penalty, James Owen's 6-y-o is strongly fancied to follow up. Kodi Fire arrives in form, and he can get the better of Amused for the forecast position.

  1. GREAT BLASKET (IRE)
  2. KODI FIRE (IRE)
  3. AMUSED (IRE)

races.name: Knight Frank East Anglia Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
PANELLI ran well fitted with headgear as a 3-y-o, so with a visor now applied he can step forward from his 2 runs back from a break last month. He could be the answer in the opener, though Home Hero isn't taken lightly under a penalty for his Sandown success, with Stormy Music also a contender.

  1. PANELLI
  2. HOME HERO (IRE)
  3. STORMY MUSIC

races.name: Knight Frank Suffolk Heritage Nursery
races.verdict:
LORD RAGNAR improved again when opening his account at Newcastle at the third attempt, before getting worn down only late on in a Lingfield nursery last time. He is taken to see off the challenge of the hat-trick seeking Emerald Bay, while High Calibre could fare best of the nursery debutants.

  1. LORD RAGNAR (IRE)
  2. EMERALD BAY (IRE)
  3. HIGH CALIBRE

races.name: Knight Frank Woodbridge EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
FAST PERFORMER made an encouraging start when runner-up at Nottingham in July, the winner scoring again next time, and he can build on that effort to go one better. Kaboom represents a yard well capable of readying a newcomer and is the pick for second, over fellow debutant Scienza.

  1. FAST PERFORMER
  2. KABOOM (IRE)
  3. SCIENZA

races.name: Knight Frank Cambridge Connections Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CERRO BLANCO sets a lofty standard on what he achieved in 2 starts on the Rowley Mile course here in the spring and is impossible to oppose back in much calmer waters.

  1. CERRO BLANCO
  2. NOTHING BUT LOVE
  3. TACTICALIST

races.name: Knight Frank Eastern Counties Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Preference is for MINHAD who made the frame at Sandown last time despite not getting the race run to suit (the second and third have both won since). He can double his tally for the season as he goes up in trip, with High Fibre feared most having made a bright start for James Owen. Koala Rose completes the shortlist.

  1. MINHAD
  2. HIGH FIBRE (IRE)
  3. KOALA ROSE (IRE)

races.name: Knight Frank Handicap
races.verdict:
EDUCATOR has benefited from the application of blinkers, comfortably getting off the mark for the year at Yarmouth 9 days ago, and he is fancied to score again under a penalty. Didaar has made a positive start for his new stable and could be the main danger, ahead of Seeking Charles.

  1. EDUCATOR
  2. DIDAAR (IRE)
  3. SEEKING CHARLES (FR)

races.name: Wasdell Group Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
races.verdict:
DOUBLE RED gets the vote on just his second start over 1½m. Oasis Sunrise and Virtue Diligence also appeal in a tight handicap.

  1. DOUBLE RED
  2. OASIS SUNRISE (IRE)
  3. VIRTUE DILIGENCE

races.name: Reecer Group Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
DOWNONMAINSTREET is the one to beat, while Calef and newcomer Rogue Dakota both look credible dangers.

  1. DOWNONMAINSTREET (IRE)
  2. CALEF (IRE)
  3. ROGUE DAKOTA (IRE)

races.name: Dunraven Windows Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
races.verdict:
ROGUE BULLET hasn't been long with the excellent James Owen yard and can resume winning ways. Solar Edge and Moe's Legacy both have solid claims in a competitive sprint.

  1. ROGUE BULLET (IRE)
  2. SOLAR EDGE
  3. MOE'S LEGACY

races.name: Happy Birthday Colin Spencer Handicap
races.verdict:
A return to calmer waters may see REVELANCE open her account for the season. Lightly-raced 3-y-o Windbreaker is feared most, with Serenity Blue another to consider following a strong-travelling display over 1¼m last time.

  1. REVELANCE
  2. WINDBREAKER
  3. SERENITY BLUE

races.name: LSL Racing Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
races.verdict:
Handicap debutant CLEMENTINES STAR is fancied to follow up her Thirsk success. Sydney Rock is potentially well treated on 2-y-o form and looks the main danger.

  1. CLEMENTINES STAR
  2. SYDNEY ROCK
  3. ESPONA BAY (IRE)

races.name: Chepstow Plant International Supports Chepstow Centenary Handicap
races.verdict:
This looks a good opportunity for HALLANDALE BEACH to follow up his recent comfortable C&D success at the expense of Pull The Rug.

  1. HALLANDALE BEACH
  2. PULL THE RUG (IRE)
  3. RED SNAPPER

races.name: JenningsBet In Bexhill On Sea Apprentice Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
Multiple course winner RIVER WHARFE wasn't beaten far at Windsor last time and gets the nod in a race which may not take a great deal of winning. Valadero and Port Hedland can also make their presence felt.

  1. RIVER WHARFE
  2. VALADERO (IRE)
  3. PORT HEDLAND

races.name: JenningsBet Ladies Day Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
There should be more to come from THE MONKEY KING and he can get off the mark at the third time of asking. Regalism is also a likely improver and looks the obvious danger.

  1. THE MONKEY KING
  2. REGALISM (IRE)
  3. FOSCARINI (IRE)

races.name: JenningsBet In Hastings Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for KONDRATIEV WAVE, who bounced back from a rare poor run when second at Windsor last month and remains fairly treated. Gone Rogue may provide the chief threat.

  1. KONDRATIEV WAVE (IRE)
  2. GONE ROGUE (IRE)
  3. DANEHILL STAR (IRE)

races.name: JenningsBet In Basingstoke Brighton Challenge Cup Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
SARANGPUR has thrived since joining Richard Hughes, winning 3 of his 4 starts. A 4 lb rise looks very fair for his latest success and he is fancied to score again. Multiple course winner Bohemian Breeze is feared most.

  1. SARANGPUR (IRE)
  2. BOHEMIAN BREEZE (IRE)
  3. NIBRAS GOLD (IRE)

races.name: JenningsBet Top Staff Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
GEARING'S POINT was a ready winner of a similar event here in June and backed that up with a solid run at Epsom. She makes some appeal if bouncing back from a below-par effort earlier in the week. Dream of Ithaca may provide the chief threat.

  1. GEARING'S POINT
  2. DREAM OF ITHACA
  3. FOINIX

races.name: JenningsBet In Brighton Handicap
races.verdict:
SILVER TRUMPET looks capable of defying a 2 lb rise for his win at Epsom with conditions in his favour again. The in-form Serenity Dream is the obvious threat.

  1. SILVER TRUMPET
  2. SERENITY DREAM (IRE)
  3. JUST JUMP (IRE)

races.name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
DISTILLATION won with little to spare at Wolverhampton, but a 3 lb rise may still not be enough to prevent the follow up in a similarly weak affair. Singarda is likely to be on the premises if putting a below-par effort at Ripon behind him, with Miss Mambo tentative pick of the remainder.

  1. DISTILLATION (FR)
  2. SINGARDA
  3. MISS MAMBO (IRE)

races.name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
ELASHGAR ran well in a race that has already been franked at Thirsk on his latest outing and is fancied to notch a second success upped to a trip that should suit. Gloriola and Here Comes Louie rate the principal threats.

  1. ELASHGAR (IRE)
  2. GLORIOLA
  3. HERE COMES LOUIE

races.name: Simon Davis Big 60th Birthday Bash Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
FILLY EILISH showed the benefit of a breathing operation when getting off the mark over C&D 10 days ago and that form has been franked since so she looks a big player under a penalty. Kiss Me My Love bounced back from a lamentable York effort to win at Redcar 8 days ago but now switches from turf to all-weather, while Dream Illusion has won twice over C&D this year and can take a hand.

  1. FILLY EILISH (IRE)
  2. KISS ME MY LOVE (IRE)
  3. DREAM ILLUSION

races.name: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
BULLRIDER has shaped with promise on both starts to date and gets the nod to make it third time lucky with the step up to 1m likely to suit. Baarberini's debut form is working out quite well and he's an obvious threat, while Quest For Glory also enters the reckoning following a much-improved effort at Lingfield.

  1. BULLRIDER (IRE)
  2. BAARBERINI
  3. QUEST FOR GLORY

races.name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
PICKERSGILL went about things in her typically less-than-economical manner when runner-up over C&D just 10 days ago but rather bumped into one that day so a reproduction of that effort could be enough. Miraculous was forced wide throughout when tried at 5f last time and should be better suited by the return to 6f off a much-reduced mark, while Court Drive is also respected.

  1. PICKERSGILL (IRE)
  2. MIRACULOUS (IRE)
  3. COURT DRIVE (IRE)

races.name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
JESSE LUC has a much better draw than last time and can record a first success of the season from a handy mark. Dorney Lake and Baba Reza are also a well-treated pair and should be thereabouts.

  1. JESSE LUC
  2. DORNEY LAKE
  3. BABA REZA

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for several but the vote goes to ULTRASOUL who represents a top yard and can extend his winning streak. Spinning Wheel is interesting now switched to the all-weather and rates a big danger, while El Burhan can play a part for minor money.

  1. ULTRASOUL (IRE)
  2. SPINNING WHEEL
  3. EL BURHAN (IRE)

races.name: Download The At The Races App Handicap
races.verdict:
MEET ME IN MERAKI has returned from a break in good heart, runner-up at Ffos Las on his latest outing when beaten only by one who scored again next time. He could be ready to get back to winning ways, though Luan isn't taken lightly in his hat-trick bid, with Golspie completing the shortlist.

  1. MEET ME IN MERAKI
  2. LUAN (FR)
  3. GOLSPIE (IRE)

Prix Du Parc Napoleon Iii Handicap
Prix Des Proprietaires De Paray-le-fresil Handicap

Prix De La Porte De Montreuil - Attele
Prix De La Porte D'italie - Attele
